item.title: Informe desde París: Gobierno anuncia ayudas para el precio de la gasolina
item.description: El Gobierno francés anunció la prolongación de las ayudas a los combustibles para los conductores que "recorren muchos kilómetros" hasta el próximo 31 de diciembre. La medida no es nueva, pues lleva implementándose desde que los precios empezaron a subir desde la primavera y que se han agravado por el cierre prolongado del estrecho de Ormuz. Por otro lado, el país se prepara para la visita del papa León XIV, que será recibido por el presidente Emmanuel Macron el viernes. Informa nuestra periodista Natalia Ruiz Giraldo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Trump sparks debate over diesel export ban
item.description: The Trump administration's suggestion that it could ban or limit diesel exports has sparked furious backlash from the American oil industry. Politicians are trying to bring down soaring energy prices ahead of the midterm election in November, but critics say a ban would cause supply problems and higher prices both at home and abroad. Also in this edition - the OECD says the global economy is withstanding the energy shock better than expected, partly thanks to AI investment. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Xi-Trump summit: China’s state car has already proved a match for the US ‘Beast’
item.description: US President Donald Trump has made no secret of how little he agrees with his predecessor, Joe Biden, on many things. So, as Chinese President Xi Jinping is about to arrive in Washington on Wednesday, local time, there is one object that may offer a small moment of entertaining comparison between the two American leaders: Xi’s car. Xi is expected to bring his own ride – a custom-built Hongqi N701, the Chinese state limousine that has accompanied him on overseas trips since 2022. In a brief... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
